info.title: Internal Agent Registry v1
info.description: Konnect Agent Registry APIs: inventory and governance of agents within an organization.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of agents. Default order is most recently created first (`created_at DESC, id DESC`).

parameters.name: page[size]
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to include per page. The last page of a collection may include fewer items.

parameters.name: page[number]
parameters.description: Determines which page of the entities to retrieve.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter agents returned in the response.

status.description:
The HTTP status code of the error. Useful when passing the response
body to child properties in a frontend UI. Must be returned as an integer.

title.description:
A short, human-readable summary of the problem. It should not
change between occurences of a problem, except for localization.
Should be provided as "Sentence case" for direct use in the UI.

instance.description:
Used to return the correlation ID back to the user, in the format
kong:trace:<correlation_id>. This helps us find the relevant logs
when a customer reports an issue.

detail.description:
A human readable explanation specific to this occurence of the problem.
This field may contain request/entity data to help the user understand
what went wrong. Enclose variable values in square brackets. Should be
provided as "Sentence case" for direct use in the UI.

reason.example: must not have more than 8 characters

value.title: Forbidden
value.detail: You do not have permission to perform this action

get.description: Returns the agent's identity principals (0 or 1). An agent has at most one linked principal.

AgentFilterParameters.title: AgentFilterParameters
AgentFilterParameters.description: Filter parameters for the agent list endpoint. `name` matches the agent's display name; `slug` is the agent-level org-unique handle; `source_type` is `manual` or `remote`; `labels` filters on agent-level labels by key, e.g. `filter[labels.env]=prod`.

name.title: StringFieldFilter
name.description: Filters on the given string field value by either exact or fuzzy match.

oneOf.title: StringFieldEqualsFilter
oneOf.description: Filters on the given string field value by exact match.

oneOf.title: StringFieldContainsFilter
oneOf.description: Filters on the given string field value by fuzzy match.

oneOf.title: StringFieldOContainsFilter
oneOf.description: Returns entities that fuzzy-match any of the comma-delimited phrases in the filter string.

oneOf.title: StringFieldOEQFilter
oneOf.description: Returns entities that exact match any of the comma-delimited phrases in the filter string.

oneOf.title: StringFieldNEQFilter
oneOf.description: Filters on the given string field value by exact match inequality.

allOf.title: LabelsFieldFilter
allOf.description:
Filters on the resource's `labels` field. Filters must use dot-notation to identify
the label key that will be used to filter the results. For example:
  - `filter[labels.owner]`
  - `filter[labels.owner][neq]=kong`
  - `filter[labels.env]=dev`
  - `filter[labels.env][ocontains]=dev,test`

created_at.title: DateTimeFieldFilter
created_at.description: Filters on the given datetime (RFC-3339) field value.

oneOf.title: DateTimeFieldImplicitEqualsFilter
oneOf.description: Value strictly equals given RFC-3339 formatted timestamp in UTC

eq.description: Value strictly equals given RFC-3339 formatted timestamp in UTC

lt.description: Value is less than the given RFC-3339 formatted timestamp in UTC

lte.description: Value is less than or equal to the given RFC-3339 formatted timestamp in UTC

gt.description: Value is greater than the given RFC-3339 formatted timestamp in UTC

gte.description: Value is greater than or equal to the given RFC-3339 formatted timestamp in UTC

page.description: Contains pagination query parameters and the total number of objects returned.

AgentListItem.description: A list item — a logical agent. See `Agent`.

description.example: Reports current weather and short-term forecasts.

overview.description: The optional catalog-owned overview, if set. See `Agent.overview`.

store_authorization.description: Whether a fetch credential is stored — see `Agent.store_authorization`.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description:
Labels store metadata of an entity that can be used for filtering an entity list or for searching across entity types. 

Keys must be of length 1-63 characters, and cannot start with "kong", "konnect", "mesh", "kic", or "_".

implementation.description: The referenced AI Gateway agent — see `Agent.implementation`.

created_at.description: When the logical agent was first registered.

updated_at.description: When the agent itself was last updated. Version writes, including refresh, do not change it.

AgentSlug.description: Org-unique, human-readable handle for the agent. Required on create, and mutable via `PATCH /agents/{agentId}` (kept org-unique). Used for lookup and declarative/config reference (filter by it, then operate by `id`); a rename invalidates any config that referenced the old slug. Identity for authz and links remains the UUID `id`.

AgentDisplayName.description: Catalog-owned display name for the agent, agent-level and mutable. Required on create.

AgentOverview.example: Reports current weather and short-term forecasts.
AgentOverview.description: Optional catalog-owned overview for the agent, agent-level and mutable. It is the agent's `description`; when unset, `description` is absent.

AgentSourceType.description:
The agent-level source set through create and `PATCH /agents/{agentId}`. `manual`: the card is pasted through the version endpoints, and no remote host is configured. `remote`: the card is fetched from a host (see `hostname`) and refreshable.

This reflects only that agent-level setting. It does not reflect a source created through `/agents/{agentId}/source`, so an agent with an `ai_gateway` source there still reads `manual`.

AgentHostname.description:
Hostname a `remote` source's card is fetched from. A bare ASCII hostname: no scheme, port, path or userinfo, and not a bare IP address. A port is rejected as an invalid `hostname` rather than ignored, since the fetch is always HTTPS on port 443. An internationalized name must be supplied as its A-label (punycode) form — `xn--r8jz45g.jp`, not `例え.jp`, which is rejected as an invalid `hostname`. Callers convert it; the API does not.

The stored value is normalized — lowercased, with any trailing dot removed — and responses return that normalized value, which is the hostname that will actually be fetched. Comparison is against the normalized form: submitting a hostname that normalizes to the stored one is not a change. `maxLength` applies to the normalized value.

AgentImplementation.description: An agent's link to the AI Gateway agent that backs it — the stored reference plus its own id and timestamps. The registry never resolves the reference; clients resolve it against AI Gateway.

agent_id.description: The id of the agent this implementation belongs to.

gateway_control_plane_id.description: The AI Gateway control plane uuid that hosts the linked agent.

gateway_agent_id.description: The text or uuid identifier of the AI Gateway agent.

updated_at.description: When the link was last updated.

AgentPrincipalList.description: A paginated page of an agent's principals (0 or 1).

AgentPrincipal.description: An agent's link to the Kong Identity principal that represents it — the stored reference plus its own id and timestamps. The registry does not manage the principal itself; clients manage it via Kong Identity.

principal_id.description: The linked Kong Identity principal's id, scoped to `directory_id`.

directory_id.description: The id of the directory that hosts the principal.

updated_at.description: When the link was last updated.

AgentSort.name: sort
AgentSort.description:
Sort agents by specified fields. Supported sort attributes are:
- name
- created_at
- updated_at

`name` sorts on the agent's display name. Defaults to `created_at`, most
recent first (ties broken by id).

schema.title: SortQuery
schema.description:
The `asc` suffix is optional as the default sort order is ascending.
The `desc` suffix is used to specify a descending order.
Multiple sort attributes may be provided via a comma separated list.
JSONPath notation may be used to specify a sub-attribute (eg: 'foo.bar desc').

AgentIdPath.name: agentId
AgentIdPath.description: Stable logical-agent identifier (shared across all versions of the agent).

konnectAccessToken.description: The Konnect access token is meant to be used by the Konnect dashboard and the decK CLI authenticate with.

personalAccessToken.description:
The personal access token is meant to be used as an alternative to basic-auth when accessing Konnect via APIs.
You can generate a Personal Access Token (PAT) from the [personal access token page](https://cloud.konghq.com/global/account/tokens/) in the Konnect dashboard.
The PAT token must be passed in the header of a request, for example:
`curl -X GET 'https://global.api.konghq.com/v2/users/' --header 'Authorization: Bearer kpat_xgfT...'`

systemAccountAccessToken.description:
The system account access token is meant for automations and integrations that are not directly associated with a human identity.
You can generate a system account Access Token by creating a system account and then obtaining a system account access token for that account.
The access token must be passed in the header of a request, for example:
`curl -X GET 'https://global.api.konghq.com/v2/users/' --header 'Authorization: Bearer spat_i2Ej...'`
